item.title: What Is AI Security? Risks, Challenges, and How to Stay Ahead
item.description:
📄 Source: Prompt Security Blog
👤 Author: Prompt Security Team | 📅 Date: 2023-11-15
Artificial Intelligence Cybersecurity Data Protection
The article discusses AI security, highlighting the unique risks such as data poisoning, model theft, and adversarial attacks that threaten AI systems. It outlines challenges like the complexity of AI models and lack of standards, and recommends strategies including robust data management, continuous model monitoring, and regulatory compliance to protect AI technologies. Emphasizing proactive measures, the article stresses the importance of safeguarding AI to maintain trust and security in AI-driven applications.

item.title: AI Acceptable Use Policy: What It Is, Why It Matters, and How to Create One
item.description:
📄 Source: Prompt Security Blog
👤 Author: Prompt Security Team | 📅 Date: 2024-04-15
Artificial Intelligence Governance Ethics in AI Data Privacy and Security
An AI Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) is a formal document that defines appropriate and inappropriate uses of AI within an organization to ensure ethical, secure, and compliant AI deployment. It helps mitigate risks such as data breaches and bias, supports regulatory compliance, and promotes responsible AI use aligned with organizational values. The article outlines key steps to create an effective AUP, including defining scope, stakeholder engagement, specifying acceptable and prohibited uses, addressing privacy and security, and establishing enforcement mechanisms.
